purpose: Cross-sector holdout created after router commit dc9a345; the frozen router may not be changed from this result and rescored as untouched.

tasks.pattern: filter and rank a non-percentage derived measure
tasks.gold_sql: SELECT block, ROUND(1.0 * harvest_tonnes / cultivated_hectares, 1) AS tonnes_per_hectare FROM field_harvest WHERE season = 'Monsoon' AND year = 2024 ORDER BY tonnes_per_hectare DESC, block
phrasings: 2024 Monsoon crop yield tonnes per hectare block wise highest first
for Monsoon 2024 divide harvest tonnes by cultivated hectares for each block and rank best first
show every block's 2024 Monsoon tonnes per hectare, top to bottom

tasks.gold_sql: SELECT station, ROUND(AVG(nitrate_mg_l), 1) AS average_nitrate_mg_l FROM river_samples WHERE year = 2024 GROUP BY station ORDER BY average_nitrate_mg_l ASC, station
phrasings: 2024 average nitrate mg/l for each river station, lowest first
station wise mean nitrate in 2024 sort low to high
compare all stations by their 2024 average nitrate, smallest first

tasks.pattern: percentage-point change by a new grouping dimension
tasks.gold_sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT school, year, 100.0 * children_attended / children_enrolled AS attendance_percent FROM school_attendance WHERE year IN (2023, 2024)) SELECT school, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN attendance_percent END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN attendance_percent END), 1) AS change_pp FROM rates GROUP BY school ORDER BY school
phrasings: school wise attendance percentage-point change from 2023 to 2024
for each school give 2024 attendance rate minus 2023 rate in percentage points
how many pp did attended over enrolled move between 2023 and 2024 for every school

tasks.pattern: join a new key and rank a derived percentage
tasks.reference: The selected tables have the same org_unit-year grain and can be matched on org_unit and year. Percent means 100.0 times numerator divided by the stated denominator.
tasks.gold_sql: SELECT b.org_unit, ROUND(100.0 * s.spent_lakh / b.approved_lakh, 1) AS utilisation_percent FROM approved_budget AS b JOIN actual_spend AS s ON b.org_unit = s.org_unit AND b.year = s.year WHERE b.year = 2024 ORDER BY utilisation_percent ASC, b.org_unit
phrasings: join 2024 approved and spend by org unit and year, utilisation percentage lowest first
for every org unit show 2024 spent lakh as percent of approved lakh, match both tables and sort smallest
2024 budget use percentage by org unit from the two files, low to high

tasks.pattern: missing value lookup with unfamiliar dimensions
tasks.gold_sql: SELECT landscape, round FROM habitat_checks WHERE species_count IS NULL ORDER BY landscape, round
phrasings: where is species count blank? show landscape and round
list landscape and survey round with missing species_count
species count not available for which landscape rounds, don't call blank zero
